scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run preview --workspace frontend"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
